tickets.description_md:
Version: 1.2.0. Browser: Chrome on Windows, Sydney time.

Steps: 1. Open the task list in the morning. 2. Click "Due today".

Expected: only "Book the car service", which is due today.

Actual: the list shows "Pay the water bill (due 2026-11-11)", which was due yesterday, and not the task due today.

Happens every morning before about 11am; by the afternoon the filter is right again.
